chordInfo.name: Augmented Chords
chordInfo.subtitle: Explore the mysterious, ascending quality of augmented chords - symmetrical harmony that creates tension and chromatic movement.

boxes.title: Interval Quality
items: Two major 3rds: Equal division of octave

boxes.title: Scale Relationship
items: Derived from: Major triad with raised 5th
Altered dominant: V+ resolving to I
Whole-tone: All notes from whole-tone scale

voicingGroups.title: Essential Augmented Chord Voicings
voicingGroups.tipDescription: These are the fundamental augmented chord voicings for guitar.

items.title: Chromatic Bass Line with Augmented
items.description: Classic chromatic ascending line using the augmented chord as a passing chord - heard in Beatles songs like "Oh! Darling".

techniqueItems: Practice the small finger movement from major to augmented
Focus on smooth chromatic voice leading
Listen for the ascending quality of the augmented 5th
Use augmented chords sparingly for maximum effect
applicationItems: Adds mystery and tension to progressions
Essential for Beatles and classic rock styles
Perfect for building suspense in arrangements

practiceExercises.title: Practice Exercises
practiceExercises.tipDescription: These exercises will help you master augmented chords and their applications.

exercises.title: Exercise 1: Major to Augmented Transitions
exercises.detail: Practice raising the 5th by one fret from each major chord
exercises.tip: Listen for the characteristic ascending tension of the augmented 5th

concepts.title: Augmented Chord Symmetry
items: Only 4 unique augmented triads exist (due to symmetry)
Augmented 7th: C+7 used as altered dominant
Coltrane Changes: Augmented triads divide the octave
